record.title: NP-F550-form-factor 2S Li-ion pack, 7.2 V nominal, 2600 mAh — the Microduck's removable battery (Sony InfoLITHIUM L-series shape; maker of the fitted pack unidentified)
record.why: THE FORM FACTOR IS KNOWN, THE FITTED PACK IS NOT. Pollen's press kit says the battery is a removable NP-F550, 2600 mAh, ~1 h (docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §9; docs/PARTS.md row 35), and the runtime maps 6.6–8.2 V under load to 0–100 % (model.rs:99-128) — a 2-series Li-ion pack. But 'NP-F550' names Sony's ORIGINAL L-series pack, which Sony rates 1500 mAh / 10.8 Wh, so a 2600 mAh 'NP-F550' is necessarily a THIRD-PARTY pack in Sony's shape, and no source names whose. This folder therefore carries: (1) a representative vendor page for a 2600 mAh 7.2 V pack in this shape — Duracell DR5 'Replacement Sony NP-F330/NP-F550 Battery 7.2V 2600mAh', FETCHED 2026-09-02 (docs/, sha256 in PROVENANCE.json), quoted verbatim in electrical.part.json; (2) a second vendor sheet, Deity's NP-F550 (3350 mAh, LG 18650 cells), as evidence of what cell type these packs use — NOT the fitted pack; (3) Sony's own specification page as CANNOT DETERMINE: every Sony host tried (sony.com.au, sony.co.uk, sony.com, sony-asia.com, sony.com.hk, sony.jp, pro.sony, electronics.sony.com) answered 403 or 404 to curl and to WebFetch on 2026-09-02 — the URLs are in electrical.part.json unknowns, and a search-engine snippet is not a source. WHAT SETTLES IT: the label on a shipped pack (maker, cell, Wh, certification marks), or Pollen naming the supplier. The mesh envelope 38.6 x 20.6 x 70.8 mm (Pollen's np_f970 mesh, PARTS.md row 35) is the geometric fact this folder already had.
record.subsector_why: the shelf already uses battery_pack for lipo_2s_shorty_pack.
record.lifecycle_why: the fitted pack's maker is unknown, so its lifecycle cannot be checked. Duracell's DR5 page carried no lifecycle statement on 2026-09-02.
record.origin_why: the electrical figures in electrical.part.json come from FETCHED vendor pages (Duracell DR5 page, Deity NP-F550 sheet), byte for byte in docs/ with sha256 in PROVENANCE.json. The dimensions come from Pollen's own simulation mesh (a vendor artefact, CC BY-SA-NC, cited in docs/PARTS.md). Not 'standard': no published standard defines the NP-F shape. Not 'measured': no physical pack has been on a bench here.
record.bbox_basis: CITED, NOT MEASURED HERE: Pollen's `np_f970` mesh bbox in its own file frame, reference/pollen-microduck-simulator/assembled/measured.json via docs/PARTS.md row 35 ('mesh is named F970 but its envelope 38.6 x 20.6 x 70.8 is an NP-F550'). Duracell's DR5 page states 'Dimensions 70 × 38 × 20 mm' for its pack — consistent to the millimetre in every axis. Order is [width, thickness, length].
record.used_by_why: placed in the trunk on power_support (docs/PARTS.md rows 3, 35).
